cases.statement: Native guard subjects retain complete compiler, canonical declaration and bytes, actual nine-member context and validated provenance without inventing Checked contracts.
The native_recovery_guard family has exactly seven ordered cases, six non-context clauses and contract_validation stage; its preflights do not extend the root roster.
Analysis and canonical_validation retain the actual same context association and exact ordered role partition; equal contents do not prove object identity.
IR-free native origins and typed coordinates identify the complete declaration, real action binding, effect and member occurrences; observations do not create origins.
Full AtomKey forward and action queries preserve both executed resolutions and exact usage lookup without converting unknown or absent into pure, unconditional or zero.
Native bounds preserve declared and effective ceilings, consulted peers, checked arithmetic order and all five typed failure payloads without root multipliers.
Both eager port results retain closed full payloads while the first forward-before-action failure controls the native verdict before the zero shortcut.
Only an actual frozen containment call yields its Boolean fact: true is Proven and false is Unproven; skipped calls are not invented.
Native evaluation preserves the eleven-field record, four native bases, twelve selected branches and exact legacy verdict without reason parsing.
Typed countermodels retain all fourteen fields and three-field assignments; structural violations use exact non-countermodel witnesses and local reachability never proves root reachability.
Native prerequisites, typed references, supporting facts and all consumers retain applicability, original stage and origin; observed false containment is not upgraded to Proven.
Selected historical imports bind each exact owner, name, full source and recursively closed descriptor; unknown owners and same-name latest fallbacks reject.
Native input Scope excludes generated results and witnesses; the independent non-root fragment and separate finite witness DAG cannot grant root CompleteView.
Every native descriptor is concretely closed, source-pinned, ranked, width-exact and bounded, including all parent variants and imported recursive dependencies.
The distinct current native tuple binds all complete registered content, applied attribution, selected sources and closed tables; frozen old editions reject without relabelling.
Registered shape admission never implies capture, support or activation; direct, portable and private RootExport issuance deny the incomplete native edition.
